listing.name: Omega's External Settings 1.1.2
listing.summary: So, are you like me, and definitely didn't go into the vanilla files to change certain values because you wanted to make things more fun (or absolutely insane, because why not)?
listing.aiSummary: Allows users to modify vanilla game settings through a separate settings file without editing the original game files.

description:
So, are you like me, and

definitely

didn't go into the vanilla files to change certain values because you wanted to make things more fun (or absolutely insane, because why not)?

...yeah, about that.

Now you (...and I, lmao)

don't have to do that

, with Omega's External Settings!

With what is unironically a DIY toolkit, you can go into the settings.json file of this mod and change vanilla settings like fleet size, the maximum size of battles, and even how many S-Mods you can put on your ships, all without touching the vanilla settings.json file!

Omega's External Settings 1.0

(Disclaimer, this mod does not actually make changes on its own, it just acts as a way for users, myself included, to make some of the changes they want without going into the vanilla settings.json file to do so.)

(Secondary Disclaimer, as with

Colonial Ascension

, which by the way is still usable even if the mod's page says "merged", this mod can be independently updated with a simple version number change...unless Starsector itself adds an update that completely changes the settings.json in a way that makes this mod nonfunctional, but...I doubt that. Feel free to throw me a ping in the Unofficial Starsector Discord if it does, even if I'm not really sure

what

I'd be able to do about

that

.)

aiDescription: Provides a way to adjust core game parameters like fleet size, battle limits, and S-Mod capacity through a dedicated configuration file. This avoids direct modification of the game's original settings, making changes safer and easier to manage. The mod acts as a toolkit for users who want to customize gameplay without touching the vanilla files.
